payload.summary: execute-tier.md Phase-3.5 dispatcher-wrap (line 33) says 'release all after the batch returns' — for run_in_background=true spawns this fires immediately (Agent() returns in ms), releasing task:<id> right after spawn. Next tick's pipeline-resume S2 outer_claim on the same key would then succeed again and double-spawn onto the same task. main.md's own S2/SLS/RLC/DRS/QA-DRAIN dispatcher-wraps all carry an explicit LOCK-LIFETIME comment (no release on background-spawn success, TTL-bound instead) — execute-tier.md's Phase-3.5 text predates that fix and was never updated to match.
payload.found_during: FIX-WF2-SUPERVISED-HOLD-NO-PO-SIDE-GOAHEAD-PRODUCER BOUNDED-1 dispatch — applied LOCK-LIFETIME-safe behavior manually instead of the literal stale text to avoid the double-spawn class
payload.suggested_fix: Update execute-tier.md Phase-3.5 (lines 33-66) to match the LOCK-LIFETIME convention documented at main.md S2/SLS/RLC/DRS/QA-DRAIN — no release in the success path for background spawns; release only on a throw before the agent handed off.
